# shopify_web_presence (Resource)

A market web presence: the subfolder (such as `/fr-ch`) or domain a market is served from, with its locales. Link it to markets with `web_presence_ids` on `shopify_market`. Set exactly one of `subfolder_suffix` and `domain_id`. The locales must already be enabled and published on the shop. The shop's primary-domain presence can't be deleted: set `adopt_existing = true` to manage it. Import with the subfolder suffix or, for a domain presence, the domain host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Locales must already be enabled and published on the shop.
resource "shopify_web_presence" "ch" {
  subfolder_suffix  = "ch"
  default_locale    = "de"
  alternate_locales = ["fr", "it"]
}

# The shop's primary-domain presence can't be created or deleted, only adopted.
resource "shopify_web_presence" "primary" {
  domain_id      = "gid://shopify/Domain/1234567890"
  default_locale = "de"
  adopt_existing = true
}

resource "shopify_market" "ch" {
  handle           = "ch"
  name             = "Switzerland"
  enabled          = true
  web_presence_ids = [shopify_web_presence.ch.id]

  conditions = {
    regions = ["CH"]
  }

  currency_settings = {
    base_currency    = "CHF"
    local_currencies = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_locale` (String) Locale served at the root, e.g. `de`. Must be enabled and published on the shop.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing web presence with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `alternate_locales` (Set of String) Further locales, served as language-specific subfolders. Must be enabled and published on the shop. Unset means unmanaged; `[]` clears them.
- `domain_id` (String) GID of an existing `Domain` to serve from. Domains themselves are not managed. Can't be combined with `subfolder_suffix`.
- `subfolder_suffix` (String) Market-specific suffix of the subfolder, e.g. `ch` for `/fr-ch`. Two or more lowercase letters. Can't be combined with `domain_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Web presence GID.
- `root_urls` (Map of String) Root URL for each locale.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <subfolder suffix> or, for a domain presence, <domain host>
terraform import shopify_web_presence.ch ch
terraform import shopify_web_presence.primary shop.example.com
```
